content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate degree in CHEMISTRY (Specialization in Inorganic/Physical Chemistry) with minimum 55% marks (or an equivalent grade system) from an accredited Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University; Must have cleared National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET; Candidates who have been awarded PhD shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. In case of natural calamity or bandh, interview will be conducted on the next working day. Desirable: Ph.D in Chemistry with good knowledge of subject domain

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Teaching Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of the Head, Dept. of Chemistry, RGU.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated Rs. 1,000 per class, up to a maximum of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate degree in Chemistry (Specialization in Inorganic/Physical Chemistry) with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade; NET (UGC/CSIR) or SLET/SET cleared; Ph.D holders exempted from NET/SLET/SET.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. In case of natural calamity or bandh, interview will be conducted on the next working day.

faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Walk-in interview in the office of the Head, Dept. of Chemistry, RGU.

faq.answer: Purely temporary for a period of 1 (one) semester. Service may be extendable, if needed by the University.
